text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
How was that, Trainer?! Did Golshi-chan's 
explosive run get burned into your brain 
forever?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Right, right? Right about now, the whole 
world's in a storm of applause!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Man, with all this applause, are we about 
to get the Prime Meridian born right here 
in Kasai or somethin'?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, to celebrate the birth of the 
Kasai Meridian, how about we chow down on 
some live sea bream, eh?!

After that, I had to use all my strength 
to stop Gold Ship, who was running toward 
the Akashi Strait with a fishing net on 
her shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"You say something good every now and 
then! I was just getting tired of the 
ground anyway!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
An unprecedented aerial race— why not let 
our generation pull it off?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, to start things 
off, how 'bout we go observe some wild 
airplanes!

After that, I ended up being dragged along 
for some plane watching, much like 
birdwatching.
